summary: Twelve concrete, comment-endorsed tools, projects, videos, and games surfaced from a complete HN front-page comment crawl.
telegram_footer: 12 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: Metapad
items.source_story_title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.summary: A tiny open-source Windows text editor built as a Notepad replacement.
items.why_included: A long-term user praised Metapad as very fast and minimal.
items.evidence: The commenter used Metapad for years as a drop-in Notepad replacement.

evidence_sources.author: bananaboy
evidence_sources.excerpt: For a long time I used metapad as a notepad replacement

items.name: SQLite Virtual Tables
items.summary: SQLite modules that expose external data sources as queryable virtual tables.
items.why_included: A commenter called the feature amazing and potentially extremely useful.
items.evidence: The commenter highlighted mounting a filesystem or other source as a SQL database.

evidence_sources.author: andai
evidence_sources.excerpt: You can "mount" your filesystem (or anything else) as a SQL database, wtf. That's amazing.

items.name: Steampipe
items.summary: A plugin hub for querying cloud services and APIs with SQL.
items.why_included: A commenter directly suggested Steampipe as a practical extension-based implementation.
items.evidence: The recommendation pointed to Steampipe's SQLite and PostgreSQL extensions.

evidence_sources.author: hantusk
evidence_sources.excerpt: Check out https://hub.steampipe.io/, available as sqlite/postgtesql extensions

items.name: ComfyUI
items.source_story_title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.summary: A node-based local interface for building and running generative-image workflows.
items.why_included: A hands-on user recommended it for precise background and watermark removal.
items.evidence: The commenter uses ComfyUI for detailed image cleanup and suggested it as an alternative.

evidence_sources.author: razster
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using ComfyUI to do fine background and watermark removal. Might take a look into that as an alternative.

items.name: LineageOS
items.source_story_title: New EU-wide product repair rules come into force
items.summary: A community Android distribution that extends support for older phones.
items.why_included: A user kept an LG G2 useful through six major Android generations.
items.evidence: The commenter used LineageOS to upgrade an LG G2 through Android 11.

evidence_sources.author: yonatan8070
evidence_sources.excerpt: through LineageOS I updated it all the way to Android 11.

items.name: AI Chip Architectures
items.summary: A technical deep dive into modern accelerator and AI-chip architecture.
items.why_included: A reader called it one of the best AI-chip deep dives they had read.
items.evidence: The commenter found the article highly educational and strongly endorsed its depth.

evidence_sources.author: peter_d_sherman
evidence_sources.excerpt: One of the best deep-dives on AI chip architectures that I've ever read.

items.name: Geekerwan's Xiaomi XRing O2 Review
items.source_story_title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.summary: A benchmark video examining Xiaomi's prototype XRing O2 processor platform.
items.why_included: A commenter highlighted amazing early benchmark and efficiency results.
items.evidence: The recommendation points to SPEC, 3DMark, and performance-per-watt results while noting prototype status.

evidence_sources.author: cherioo
evidence_sources.excerpt: Geekerwan's review is up, with caveat that this is the prototype board, not even packaged into a phone yet, but still shows some amazing results in spec 2026, 3dmark (gpu), perf-per-watt for single core and multi-core

items.name: San Francisco in Unity
items.source_story_title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.summary: A browser-playable 3D recreation of San Francisco built from public map data.
items.why_included: A longtime resident found revisiting familiar places genuinely emotional.
items.evidence: The commenter explored recognizable yards, parks, courts, hills, and a disc-golf course.

evidence_sources.author: frankhorrigan
evidence_sources.excerpt: And genuinely this made me emotional. Was weird as hell walking around my back yard.

items.name: Watch Dogs 2
items.source_story_title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.summary: An open-world hacking game set across a detailed San Francisco Bay Area.
items.why_included: A commenter called it a great game and praised the map's building-level accuracy.
items.evidence: The commenter compared it to hacker-themed GTA and endorsed its faithful Bay Area map.

evidence_sources.author: metadat
evidence_sources.excerpt: Great game, basically GTA but you are a hacker in the Bay Area. The SF portion of the map was accurate down to every building.

items.name: ejabberd
items.summary: An open-source XMPP server used for messaging, agents, and notifications.
items.why_included: An agent-system builder called ejabberd perfect for on-demand XMPP accounts.
items.evidence: The commenter uses ejabberd in an agent communication layer that has worked well.

evidence_sources.author: pavo-etc
evidence_sources.excerpt: This has worked well since I can spin up new accounts on demand and I can use existing server software (ejabberd, perfect)

items.name: Fluux Messenger
items.summary: A modern cross-platform XMPP client for communities and organizations.
items.why_included: An agent-system builder called Fluux great in a working XMPP stack.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Fluux alongside ejabberd for agents and project notifications.

items.name: EpiForecasts Ebola Outbreak Tracker
items.source_story_title: Over 5,200 Ebola cases recorded in Congo
items.summary: A Bayesian dashboard estimating outbreak size, growth, and reproduction rates.
items.why_included: A commenter recommended it as useful for judging whether the outbreak has peaked.
items.evidence: The tracker provides current growth-rate uncertainty and reproduction-number charts.

evidence_sources.author: croemer
evidence_sources.excerpt: There's a Bayesian forecast from some folks at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine that's useful to see if the outbreak has reached peak size:
